about_short_description.short_description: TensorZero is an open-source framework for building production-grade LLM applications.

product.name: TensorZero Gateway
product.description: An open-source gateway that provides an OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint for managing LLM application calls, observability, and optimization.

product.name: TensorZero UI
product.description: A user interface that provides dashboards for observability and workflows for fine-tuning LLM models.

product.name: Static and Dynamic Evaluations
product.description: Evaluation tools for assessing LLM variants on datasets and complex workflows to test inference quality and application logic.

product.name: Fine-Tuning Workflow
product.description: A workflow integrated in the TensorZero UI for launching and managing fine-tuning jobs on LLM models.

product.name: Open-Source LLM Infrastructure Stack
product.description: A comprehensive open-source framework that unifies LLM gateway, observability, optimization, evaluation, and experimentation for production-grade applications.
